_comment: Snippet for claude_desktop_config.json. Merge the 'harness' entry into your existing 'mcpServers' object. Claude Desktop's support for remote/HTTP MCP servers with custom headers has rolled out progressively across recent versions -- if your installed version does not yet support the 'url' + 'headers' form for a team HTTP-mode connection, use the local stdio form instead (single developer, their own token, not for shared team use) until you upgrade.
